rationale: R14 (rust review #798, ripgrep full extent): a TUPLE struct's field types emit `references`, exactly like a named field's. `struct Foo(Bar);` has no `field_declaration` child — its fields sit in an `ordered_field_declaration_list`, which only the ENUM branch walked, so every tuple-struct field type was invisible: measured 13 missing `references` edges over 10 ripgrep files, all of them tuple structs (StandardStream(StandardStreamKind), LiteralStrategy(fnv::HashMap<..>), IgnoreMatch(IgnoreMatchInner), Glob(GlobInner), Override(Gitignore), ...). The generic-parameter EXCLUSION still holds from the other side: `struct Generic<T>(T, Inner)` references Inner and never T (locally bound — the R8 rule).
